faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Before you book, clear the most common doubts about how VIP Advisory works.

items.question: What if I don’t qualify for any visa?
items.answer: We tell you honestly in the session and guide you on the best next steps — even if the answer today is “not yet.”

items.question: Is the session by video call?
items.answer: Yes. It’s virtual, 1-on-1 with Ivon, on the platform that works best for you.

items.question: Will I receive anything after the session?
items.answer: Yes. When we finish, you’ll get a PDF with your personalized immigration roadmap for the next 90 days.

items.question: What is the EB-2 NIW?
items.answer: It’s a permanent-residence visa for professionals with exceptional or advanced ability who benefit the U.S. national interest. It does not require an employer sponsor.

items.question: When can I schedule the session?
items.answer: Right after payment you’ll get a link to pick an available slot on Ivon’s calendar.
